common.helpBody: On this page, you manage your profile, account, security, and other preferences. Select the desired section from the side menu (or the top bar on mobile). In the "Security" section, you can change your password and turn on two-factor authentication.

account.title: User Account
account.helpBody: To change your email, enter your current password; a verification link will be sent to the new email, and the change will only take effect after you confirm that link (you will need to log in again after the change). To verify your phone number, a 6-digit code will be sent to you, and after entering the code, the number becomes "Verified".

billing.title: Billing & Financial Documents
billing.sub: Your account's actual financial documents — tailored to your role — along with links to the financial page for full viewing.
billing.helpBody: This section contains actual financial documents relevant to your role: students have tuition, loans, scholarships, and refunds; course creators have knowledge marketplace earnings; and staff have pay slips. For full viewing and to make payments/requests, use the link in each section to go to the dedicated financial page.

wallet.sub: There is no «wallet» or prepaid balance in this system; everything is based on tuition and the financial ledger. A true summary of your financial status is provided below.

help.title: My Profile Help
help.body: On this page, you can view and edit your profile information in the «Personal», «Contact», «Account & Security», and «Role Information» sections. To change your profile picture, click the upload button on the image. The «Profile Completion» bar shows what items remain; after editing, click the «Save» button. Passwords and two-factor authentication are managed from «Account Settings».

roleScopeNotes.student: Your access includes learning, course registration, transcripts, and student services.
roleScopeNotes.instructor: Your access includes teaching, content creation, grading, and live classes for your assigned sections.
roleScopeNotes.admin: University-wide administrative access: users, academic structure, reports, and auditing.
roleScopeNotes.faculty_admin: Administrative access limited to a single faculty (departments, programs, offerings, and enrollments).
roleScopeNotes.parent: Limited access to view the progress and billing of the linked child.
roleScopeNotes.org: Management of organization members, progress reports, and organizational billing.
roleScopeNotes.ta: Teaching Assistant: assisting with teaching and grading in assigned sections.
roleScopeNotes.content_manager: Management and publication of educational content and content quality review.
roleScopeNotes.support: User support: viewing audit logs and resetting user passwords within the ticket framework.
roleScopeNotes.moderator: Moderating forums and discussions and handling violation reports.
roleScopeNotes.super_admin: Super Admin: cross-tenant access and high-level system configuration.
roleScopeNotes.finance_manager: Financial management: treasury, payroll, decrees, and receivables.
roleScopeNotes.counselor: Counselor: counseling appointments, crisis queue, and summary of related student wellbeing (within the duty of care).
roleScopeNotes.membership_operator: Membership Operator: viewing membership files and verifying applicant identities. All views are audit-logged.
roleScopeNotes.membership_manager: Membership Program Manager: in addition to viewing and approving, suspending, revoking, and reinstating memberships.
roleScopeNotes.assessor: Assessor: recording evidence and scores only for candidates assigned to you; no access to other assessors' scores.
roleScopeNotes.assessment_manager: Assessment Center Manager: project/exercise/assignment management and wash-up monitoring, without interfering with assessor grading independence.
